messages:
Sam B.: Heads-up — enterprise POC next week (Acme Corp). Need a single onboarding checklist for Hosted API keys, a short runbook for Dedicated pool requests, and VPC/private deployment steps. Can we consolidate here?
Maya R.: I'll draft the checklist. Quick Q: will they require Private (VPC) or Dedicated? We should know because lead time differs.
Sam B.: Sales says preference is Dedicated for isolation but they want fallback to Hosted for demo spikes. Also expect security questionnaire.
Priya K.: Flagging security reqs: SC-15 data residency, KMS integration, audit logs. I'll attach standard answers but need exact contact for their infosec.
Jared L.: For Dedicated pool provisioning: minimal ticket template below — please use verbatim to avoid back-and-forth.
Jared L.: ```
Title: Dedicated POC pool request — <customer-name>
Env: POC
Requested GPUs: 4 x a100-sXM
Start date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
Duration: 30 days
Networking: dedicated subnet, egress policy
Owners: <sales>, <eng-ops>
Approval: <account exec sign-off>
```
Maya R.: Nice. Add expected QPS and model(s) so infra can size. Also include fallback policy to Hosted with API key name.
Luca M.: Pricing note: for POC we offer a discounted reserved daily rate. For quoting, use POCPERF-10% SKU. I'll attach a sample quote in the deal thread.
Maya R.: VPC peering run notes (short):
```
1) Provide CIDR for customer VPC + region
2) Create VPC peering request via console -> peering -> request
3) Share peering ID + allowed routes
4) Confirm security groups allow 443 to API endpoints
5) Test with curl from customer subnet: `curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/ping`
```
Priya K.: Security Qs we couldn't auto-answer: key rotation policy, HSM vs KMS specifics. Suggest we prepare a one-page doc: 'POC security checklist' and attach to each POC ticket.
Sam B.: Can someone put the final checklist and runbooks into a single artifact (one-pager + ticket templates)? Need to hand off to the onboarding engineer by EOD tomorrow.
Maya R.: I'll create the one-pager and paste the link here when done. Will include: Hosted key creation steps, Dedicated ticket template (Jared's), VPC peering snippet, minimal test plan, and contact matrix.
POC Bot: Reminder: create onboarding ticket in #release-war-room once Dedicated request is approved.
Luca M.: Also include billing contact and promo SKU in the one-pager. I can approve the promo on the quote if the POC duration is <= 60 days.
Jared L.: Action items: 1) Maya to publish one-pager, 2) Priya to drop security Q/A doc, 3) Sam to confirm customer infosec contact, 4) Me to prep infra slot after ticket.
Sam B.: Thanks all — please post links here as you finish. :thumbsup:
